requirements.text: The ESA sample(s) shall be clearly and indelibly marked with the manufacturer's trade name or mark and the type designation.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the submitted lamp samples for a clear, indelible trade name/mark and type designation.

requirements.text: In case the ESA is (part of) a light source, the applicant shall specify the approval number according to Regulation No. 37, Regulation No. 99 or Regulation No. 128 granted to this ESA, or provide a test report by a Technical Service stating that this ESA is not mechanically interchangeable with any light source according to Regulation No. 37, Regulation No. 99 or Regulation No. 128.
requirements.test_case: Check documentation provides R37/R99/R128 approval number or Technical Service report of non-interchangeability.

requirements.text: The representative ESA system(s) shall fulfil the requirements of paragraph 6. and, if applicable, paragraph 7. of this Regulation for type approval to be granted.
requirements.test_case: Review test report showing the lamp ESA meets all paragraph 6 requirements.

requirements.text: In case the ESA is (part of) a light source and the documentation as specified in paragraph 3.2.10. is missing, approval of this ESA according to Regulation No. 10 shall not be granted.
requirements.test_case: Confirm paragraph 3.2.10 documentation is present before approval.

requirements.text: An approval mark described in paragraph 5.3. shall be affixed to every ESA conforming to a type approved under this Regulation, except that no marking is required for electrical/electronic systems built into vehicles which are approved as units.
requirements.test_case: Inspect each lamp for the R10 approval mark per paragraph 5.3.

requirements.text: The international approval mark shall be affixed in a conspicuous and easily accessible place specified on the approval communication form.
requirements.test_case: Verify mark location matches the place specified on the communication form.

requirements.text: The approval mark shall comprise a circle containing the letter "E", followed by the distinguishing number of the country granting the approval.
requirements.test_case: Inspect mark for circle with E and the approving country's number.

requirements.text: The approval mark shall comprise the number of this Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle specified in paragraph 5.3.1.
requirements.test_case: Inspect mark for "10R-" followed by the approval number to the right of the circle.

requirements.text: The ESA(s) shall be designed, constructed and fitted in such a way as to enable the vehicle, in normal conditions of use, to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Review EMC design and test results showing compliance in normal conditions of use.

requirements.text: The ESA(s) shall be tested for radiated and conducted emissions, for immunity to radiated and conducted disturbances.
requirements.test_case: Confirm test report covers radiated and conducted emissions and radiated and conducted immunity of the lamp.

requirements.text: The electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 7.
requirements.test_case: Measure broadband radiated emissions of the lamp per Annex 7 (ALSE method) and confirm a test report exists.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the ESA broadband limits shall be 62 to 52 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, and 52 to 63 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 6.
requirements.test_case: Compare Annex 7 broadband measurement over 30-400 MHz against the Appendix 6 limit line; pass if all values are below it.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the ESA broadband limit in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band shall remain constant at 63 dB microvolts/m.
requirements.test_case: Check Annex 7 broadband measurement in 400-1,000 MHz is below 63 dBµV/m.

requirements.text: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured broadband values, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.
requirements.test_case: Verify all broadband measured values in the test report are below the limit curve.

requirements.text: The emission of transient conducted disturbances of the ESA representative of its type on 12/24 V supply lines shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 7637-2 as described in Annex 10 for the levels given in Table 1.
requirements.test_case: Perform ISO 7637-2 transient emission test per Annex 10 and record pulse amplitudes.

requirements.text: The maximum allowed positive pulse amplitude of transient conducted emissions generated by the ESA shall be +75 V for vehicles with 12 V systems and +150 V for vehicles with 24 V systems, as given in Table 1.
requirements.test_case: Check measured positive transient amplitudes do not exceed +75 V (12 V) / +150 V (24 V).

requirements.text: The immunity to electromagnetic radiation of the ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) chosen from those described in Annex 9.
requirements.test_case: Perform radiated immunity test per a chosen Annex 9 method and confirm a test report exists.

requirements.text: When tested with the stripline method as described in Annex 9, the ESA shall be tested at 60 V/m in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 400 MHz frequency band (Table 2a) and at a minimum of 50 V/m over the whole 20 to 400 MHz frequency band (Table 2b).
requirements.test_case: Verify stripline test levels of 60 V/m (>90 % of band) and minimum 50 V/m over 20-400 MHz were applied.

requirements.text: When tested with the ALSE method as described in Annex 9, the ESA shall be tested at 30 V/m in over 90 per cent of the 80 to 2,000 MHz band and 10 V/m in over 90 per cent of the 2,000 to 6,000 MHz band (Table 2a), and at a minimum of 25 V/m over the whole 80 to 2,000 MHz band and 8 V/m over the whole 2,000 to 6,000 MHz band (Table 2b).
requirements.test_case: Verify ALSE test levels of 30/10 V/m (>90 % of band) and minimum 25/8 V/m were applied over 80-6,000 MHz.

requirements.text: When tested with the reverberation chamber method as described in Annex 9, the ESA shall be tested at 21 V/m in over 90 per cent of the LUF to 2,000 MHz band and 7 V/m in over 90 per cent of the 2,000 to 6,000 MHz band (Table 2a), and at a minimum of 18 V/m over the whole LUF to 2,000 MHz band and 6 V/m over the whole 2,000 to 6,000 MHz band (Table 2b).
requirements.test_case: Verify reverberation chamber test levels of 21/7 V/m (>90 % of band) and minimum 18/6 V/m were applied.

requirements.text: Where the ESA does not include an electronic oscillator with an operating frequency greater than 9 kHz, it shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.3.2. or 6.6.2. and with Annexes 5 and 8.
requirements.test_case: Review schematic/BOM to confirm absence of oscillators >9 kHz; if confirmed, narrowband test is waived.

requirements.text: While tests are performed in accordance with Annex 9, the ESA representative of its type shall be considered as complying with immunity requirements if there is no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions".
requirements.test_case: Monitor stop/position/reversing lamp outputs during Annex 9 tests; pass if no degradation of immunity related functions.

requirements.text: The immunity of ESA representative of this type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 16750-2 for starting profile and ISO 7637-2 for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b, as described in Annex 10, with the test levels given in Tables 3a and 3b.
requirements.test_case: Perform conducted transient immunity tests per Annex 10 and confirm a test report exists.

requirements.text: The starting profile shall be tested according to the functional status classification as defined in ISO 16750-1.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report classifies starting profile results per ISO 16750-1.

requirements.text: The Functional Performance Status Classification (FPSC) as in ISO 7637-1 shall be applied for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report classifies pulse results per ISO 7637-1 FPSC.

requirements.text: For pulse 1, the ESA shall meet immunity test level -75 V (12V system) or -450 V (24V system) for 500 pulses with FPSC III for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity as specified in Table 3b.
requirements.test_case: Apply pulse 1 at specified level for 500 pulses; verify FPSC III achieved.

requirements.text: For pulse 3a, the ESA shall meet immunity test level -112 V (12V system) or -150 V (24V system) for 1 h with FPSC I for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity as specified in Table 3b.
requirements.test_case: Apply pulse 3a at specified level for 1 h; verify FPSC I for immunity related functions.

requirements.text: For the 12 V system starting profile (ISO 16750-2, test level II, 10 pulses), an ESA that shall be operational during engine start phases shall reach functional status class B if it performs immunity-related functions and class D if it does not, and any other ESA shall reach class C, as given in Table 3a; the starting profile applies only to ESAs that may be installed in vehicles with an internal combustion engine started by a 12 V / 24 V starter motor.
requirements.test_case: Apply 12 V starting profile level II, 10 pulses; verify the required functional status class is achieved.

requirements.text: ESAs that are not switched, contain no switches or do not include inductive load need not be tested for transient conducted emission and shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.7.
requirements.test_case: Review circuit design; if no switching or inductive load, transient emission test is waived.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the broadband limits for the ESA shall be 62 to 52 dBµV/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, as shown in Appendix 6.
requirements.test_case: Measure broadband emissions per Annex 7 from 30 to 75 MHz and verify all values are below the logarithmically decreasing 62 to 52 dBµV/m limit.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the broadband limits for the ESA shall be 52 to 63 dBµV/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz, as shown in Appendix 6.
requirements.test_case: Measure broadband emissions per Annex 7 from 75 to 400 MHz and verify all values are below the logarithmically increasing 52 to 63 dBµV/m limit.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the broadband limit for the ESA remains constant at 63 dBµV/m.
requirements.test_case: Measure broadband emissions per Annex 7 from 400 to 1,000 MHz and verify all values are below 63 dBµV/m.

requirements.text: For the frequency range 30-75 MHz, the broadband radiated emissions of the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) shall not exceed the reference limit E = 62 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m (F in MHz), measured with a 120 kHz bandwidth (see paragraphs 6.5.2.1. and 7.10.2.1.).
requirements.test_case: Measure ESA broadband radiated emissions per Annex 7 with 120 kHz bandwidth over 30-75 MHz and verify all values are below E = 62 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m.

requirements.text: For the frequency range 75-400 MHz, the broadband radiated emissions of the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) shall not exceed the reference limit E = 52 + 15.13 log (F/75) dBµV/m (F in MHz), measured with a 120 kHz bandwidth (see paragraphs 6.5.2.1. and 7.10.2.1.).
requirements.test_case: Measure ESA broadband radiated emissions with 120 kHz bandwidth over 75-400 MHz and verify all values are below E = 52 + 15.13 log (F/75) dBµV/m.

requirements.text: For the frequency range 30-75 MHz, the narrowband radiated emissions of the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) shall not exceed the reference limit E = 52 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m (F in MHz), measured with a 120 kHz bandwidth (see paragraph 6.6.2.1.).
requirements.test_case: Measure ESA narrowband radiated emissions per Annex 8 with 120 kHz bandwidth over 30-75 MHz and verify all values are below E = 52 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m.

requirements.text: For an ESA powered by LV, a 5 µH / 50 Ω artificial network (AN) as defined in Figure 1 shall be used.
requirements.test_case: Check the ESA test set-up records show a 5 µH / 50 Ω AN per Figure 1 in the LV supply lines.

requirements.text: If not otherwise stated in Annex 7, the test measuring broadband electromagnetic emissions from the ESA shall be performed according to CISPR 25.
requirements.test_case: Review the test report to confirm the broadband radiated emission test was carried out to CISPR 25.

requirements.text: For an ESA other than one involved in "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid", the radiated broadband emission test shall be performed according to the ALSE method described in Clause 6.4 of CISPR 25.
requirements.test_case: Check the test set-up record shows the CISPR 25 Clause 6.4 ALSE arrangement (or permitted OATS alternative).

requirements.text: The radiated broadband emission limits shall apply to the ESA throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or open area test site (OATS).
requirements.test_case: Measure radiated broadband emissions from 30 to 1,000 MHz and verify all readings are below the paragraph 6.5 limits.

requirements.text: If not otherwise stated in Annex 8, the measurement of radiated narrowband electromagnetic emissions from the ESA shall be performed according to CISPR 25.
requirements.test_case: Review the narrowband emission test report and confirm the test set-up and procedure follow CISPR 25.

requirements.text: During the narrowband emission test, the ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load.
requirements.test_case: Verify in the test report that the lamp functions were operated in normal mode with all functions at maximum load during measurement.

requirements.text: The narrowband emission test shall be performed according to the ALSE method described in paragraph 6.4. of CISPR 25.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the test report shows an ALSE set-up per CISPR 25 clause 6.4 (or a CISPR 16-1-4 compliant OATS).

requirements.text: The narrowband emission limits apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or open area test site (OATS).
requirements.test_case: Verify the measured narrowband emissions across 30-1,000 MHz are below the applicable limits.

requirements.text: The narrowband emission measurements shall be performed with an average detector.
requirements.test_case: Confirm in the test report that the average detector was used for all narrowband readings.

requirements.text: The narrowband emission measurements shall be performed with a spectrum analyser or a scanning receiver, using the parameters defined in Tables 1 and 2.
requirements.test_case: Check the instrument type and settings recorded in the test report against Tables 1 and 2.

requirements.text: The ESA may comply with the requirements of any combination of the test methods (absorber chamber test according to ISO 11452-2, TEM cell testing according to ISO 11452-3, bulk current injection testing according to ISO 11452-4, stripline testing according to ISO 11452-5, reverberation chamber test according to ISO 11452-11) at the manufacturer's discretion only provided that these result in the full frequency range specified in paragraph 3.1. of this Annex being covered.
requirements.test_case: Review the immunity test report and confirm that the selected method(s) together cover 20 to 6,000 MHz without gaps.

requirements.text: For the immunity test of the ESA to electromagnetic radiation, the frequency range and general test conditions shall be based on ISO 11452-1.
requirements.test_case: Check that the test plan and report reference ISO 11452-1 for the frequency range and general conditions.

requirements.text: During the immunity test of the ESA to electromagnetic radiation, the test conditions shall be according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.test_case: Verify in the test report that the test conditions (temperature, supply voltage, etc.) follow ISO 11452-1.

requirements.text: The ESA under test shall be switched on and shall be stimulated to be in normal operation condition.
requirements.test_case: Confirm that during the test the lamp functions (position, stop, reversing) are energised and operating normally.

requirements.text: The ESA under test shall be arranged as defined in Annex 9 unless individual test methods dictate otherwise.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the test set-up photos and description against the Annex 9 arrangement.

requirements.text: Immunity measurements on the ESA shall be made in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency range with frequency steps according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.test_case: Confirm that the test report covers 20 to 6,000 MHz with ISO 11452-1 step sizes.

requirements.text: Unless otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer, the test signal modulation shall be AM (amplitude modulation), with 1 kHz modulation and 80 per cent modulation depth in the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range.
requirements.test_case: Verify that the signal generator settings for 20 to 400 MHz are AM at 1 kHz with 80 % depth.

requirements.text: Unless otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer, the test signal modulation shall be PM2 (pulse modulation type 2), Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs in the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz frequency range.
requirements.test_case: Verify that the modulation in the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz band is PM2 with Ton 3 µs and period 3,333 µs.

requirements.text: Unless otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer, the test signal modulation shall be PM3 (pulse modulation type 3), Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs in the 380 to 2,700 MHz and the 3,100 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges.
requirements.test_case: Verify that the modulation in 380 to 2,700 MHz and 3,100 to 6,000 MHz is PM3 with Ton 500 µs and period 1,000 µs.

requirements.text: The frequency step size and dwell time for the ESA immunity test shall be chosen according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report step size and dwell time against ISO 11452-1.

requirements.text: For the absorber chamber test, the "substitution method" shall be used to establish the test field conditions according to ISO 11452-2.
requirements.test_case: Check that the field calibration in the absorber chamber used the ISO 11452-2 substitution method.

requirements.text: The absorber chamber test shall be performed with vertical polarization.
requirements.test_case: Verify in the test report that the antenna polarization was vertical.

requirements.text: The TEM cell test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-3, with the method of maximum field coupling to the ESA or to the wiring harness inside the TEM-cell chosen depending on the ESA to be tested.
requirements.test_case: Check that the TEM cell test followed ISO 11452-3 and that the coupling orientation chosen is documented.

requirements.text: The bulk current injection test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-4 on a test bench, using either the BCI substitution method with the injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA, or the BCI closed loop method with the injection probe positioned at 900 mm distance to the ESA.
requirements.test_case: Verify the BCI method used and measure the probe distance: 150 mm for substitution or 900 mm for closed loop.

requirements.text: The stripline test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-5.
requirements.test_case: Check that the stripline test set-up and procedure in the report follow ISO 11452-5.

requirements.text: The reverberation chamber test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-11.
requirements.test_case: Check that the reverberation chamber test followed ISO 11452-11.

requirements.text: For immunity against transient disturbances conducted along 12/24 V supply lines, the test pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b according to ISO 7637-2 shall be applied to the supply lines as well as to other connections of the ESA which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
requirements.test_case: Apply ISO 7637-2 pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b to the lamp supply lines and to connections that may be operationally connected to them, then check the functional status against the required FPSC.

requirements.text: For immunity against transient disturbances conducted along 12/24 V supply lines, the starting profile according to ISO 16750-2 shall be applied to the supply lines as well as to other connections of the ESA which may be operationally connected to supply lines, except for ESAs that are exclusively reserved for mounting on electric vehicles (vehicles without 12V/24V starter motor).
requirements.test_case: Apply the ISO 16750-2 starting profile to the lamp supply lines and check the functional status class, unless the lamp is shown to be for EV-only use.

requirements.text: The emission of transient conducted disturbances generated by the ESA on 12/24 V supply lines shall be measured according to ISO 7637-2 on supply lines as well as on other connections of the ESA which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
requirements.test_case: Measure the conducted transient emissions of the lamp per ISO 7637-2 on its supply lines and compare them with the limits of the Regulation.

requirements.text: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which they may be subjected, they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation and enable the vehicle to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp mounting and verify after vibration/use that the position, orientation and photometric characteristics remain within the Regulation's requirements.

requirements.text: It shall not be possible for the lamps to be inadvertently maladjusted.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the fixings and verify that the lamp cannot be moved out of its fitted orientation without deliberate action or tools.

requirements.text: For all light-signalling devices, the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road, with a tolerance of ±3°.
requirements.test_case: Measure the installed reference axis of each function relative to the road plane and confirm it is parallel within ±3°.

requirements.text: For the rear position, stop and reversing lamps and rear retro-reflector (signalling devices other than side retro-reflectors and side-marker lamps), the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle, with a tolerance of ±3°.
requirements.test_case: Measure the installed reference axis relative to the vehicle median longitudinal plane and confirm it is parallel within ±3°.

requirements.text: Any specific instructions as regards fitting laid down by the manufacturer shall be complied with.
requirements.test_case: Compare the installation against the manufacturer's fitting instructions and confirm full compliance.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the height and orientation of the lamps shall be verified with the vehicle unladen and placed on a flat, horizontal surface, in the condition defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2.
requirements.test_case: Place the unladen vehicle on a flat horizontal surface and measure the lamp height and orientation in that condition.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall be fitted to the vehicle symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane (this estimate to be based on the exterior geometrical form of the lamp and not on the edge of its illuminating surface referred to in paragraph 2.10.3.).
requirements.test_case: Measure the left and right lamp positions from the median longitudinal plane using the exterior lamp form and confirm symmetry.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall be symmetrical to one another in relation to the median longitudinal plane; this requirement is not valid with regard to the interior structure of the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Compare the left and right lamps and confirm they are mirror-symmetrical externally.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.
requirements.test_case: Measure the chromaticity of each function on the left and right lamps and confirm both meet the same colour requirements.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall have substantially identical photometric characteristics.
requirements.test_case: Compare the photometric data of the left and right lamps for each function and confirm they are substantially identical.

requirements.text: In case of lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo, only two lateral logos (one on each side) or one central logo can be fitted on the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Count the logos incorporated in rear lamps and confirm at most two lateral or one central logo.

requirements.text: In case of lamps incorporating a logo, all logos that are not vehicle manufacturer or body manufacturer logos are prohibited.
requirements.test_case: Inspect any logo in the lamp and confirm it is a vehicle or body manufacturer logo.

requirements.text: The rear position, stop and reversing lamps and retro-reflector may be grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with one another only provided that all requirements regarding colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility, electrical connections and other requirements, if any, are fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Verify for each function in the combination lamp that colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility and electrical connection requirements are met.

requirements.text: The photometric and colorimetric requirements of a lamp shall be fulfilled when all other functions with which this lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF.
requirements.test_case: Measure each function's photometry and colour with all other functions of the lamp switched OFF and confirm compliance.

requirements.text: When a rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with one or more other function(s) which can be switched ON together with it, the requirements regarding colour of each of these other functions shall be fulfilled when the reciprocally incorporated function(s) and the rear position lamps are switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Switch ON the rear position lamp together with the reciprocally incorporated function and measure the colour of that function for compliance.

requirements.text: Stop lamps and direction-indicator lamps shall not be reciprocally incorporated.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp design and confirm the stop lamp does not share a common illuminating surface with a direction indicator.

requirements.text: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.14.11.1., subparagraph (a), the apparent surface of which is composed of two or more distinct parts, shall be installed in such a way that either the total area of the projection of the distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis on a plane tangent to the exterior surface of the outer lens and perpendicular to the reference axis occupies not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projection of the said apparent surface, or the minimum distance between the facing edges of two adjacent/tangential distinct parts of the apparent surface does not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis; these requirements shall not apply to a single retro-reflector.
requirements.test_case: Project the distinct parts of the apparent surface and confirm ≥60 % fill of the circumscribing quadrilateral or ≤75 mm gap between facing edges.

requirements.text: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (b) or (c), composed of two lamps marked "D" or two independent retro reflectors, shall be installed in such a way that either the projection of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis of the two lamps or retro reflectors occupies not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projections, or the minimum distance between the facing edges of the apparent surfaces of the two lamps or two independent retro reflectors does not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis.
requirements.test_case: Project the two apparent surfaces and confirm ≥60 % fill of the circumscribing quadrilateral or ≤75 mm gap.

requirements.text: Red light emitted by the rear position lamp, stop lamp and rear retro-reflector fitted on the rear of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle from the front and confirm no red light from the rear lamp is visible.

requirements.text: The maximum height above the ground shall be measured from the highest point and the minimum height from the lowest point of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis.
requirements.test_case: Measure each function's highest and lowest apparent-surface points above the ground in the reference-axis direction.

requirements.text: For the purposes of reducing the geometric visibility angles, the position of a lamp with regard to height above the ground shall be measured from the H plane.
requirements.test_case: Measure the height of the H plane above the ground and use it to justify any reduced vertical visibility angle.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of the rear position lamp, stop lamp and reversing lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Operate each function and confirm by observation and photometric check that intensity, colour and apparent surface stay constant while switched ON.

requirements.text: For the visibility of red light towards the front of a vehicle, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of the red rear lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see Annex 4).
requirements.test_case: Per Annex 4, check from Zone 1 in a transverse plane 25 m ahead of the vehicle that no part of the red apparent surface is directly visible.

requirements.text: In case of doubt, the requirement on red light visibility to the front shall be deemed fulfilled if the luminous intensity of the red light emitted to the front, as verified during type approval of the lamps, is not more than 0.25 cd per lamp taking into account the influence of the vehicle body if applicable.
requirements.test_case: Measure the red luminous intensity emitted towards the front and confirm it is not more than 0.25 cd per lamp.

requirements.text: The electrical connections shall be such that the front and rear position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps, if they exist, the side-marker lamps, if they exist, and the rear registration plate lamp can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
requirements.test_case: Operate the lighting switch and verify the rear position lamps switch ON and OFF together with front position lamps, side-marker, end-outline and registration plate lamps.

requirements.text: In the case of an interdependent lamp system, all light sources shall be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
requirements.test_case: Operate the function and confirm all light sources of the interdependent lamp system switch ON and OFF together.

requirements.text: The concealment of the rear position lamps, stop lamps, reversing lamps and rear retro-reflectors shall be prohibited.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installation and confirm the rear lamp functions are not concealable.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the reversing lamp shall be white.
requirements.test_case: Measure the chromaticity of the reversing lamp and confirm it is within the white boundaries.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the stop lamp shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Measure the chromaticity of the stop lamp and confirm it is within the red boundaries.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the rear position lamp shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Measure the chromaticity of the rear position lamp and confirm it is within the red boundaries.

requirements.text: The colour of the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Verify the retro-reflector colour is red by colorimetric check per its device approval.

requirements.text: The number of rear position lamps, stop lamps, reversing lamps and rear retro-reflectors mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Count the lamps of each function on the vehicle and compare against the individual specifications in paragraph 6.

requirements.text: The rear lamp may be installed on movable components only provided that the conditions specified in paragraphs 5.18., 5.19. and 5.20. are fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: If mounted on a movable component, verify compliance with paragraphs 5.18 to 5.20.

requirements.text: Rear position lamps and rear retro-reflectors may be installed on movable components only if at all fixed positions of the movable components the lamps on the movable components meet all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps.
requirements.test_case: With the movable component in each fixed position, check position, geometric visibility, colour and photometry of the lamps.

requirements.text: When the movable components are in a position other than a "normal position of use", the lamps installed on them shall not cause undue discomfort to road users.
requirements.test_case: With the movable component open, assess that the lamps do not cause undue discomfort (glare) to road users.

requirements.text: When the lamp is installed on a movable component and the movable component is in the "normal position(s) of use", the lamp shall always return to the position(s) specified by the manufacturer in accordance with this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Operate the movable component repeatedly and confirm the lamp returns to the manufacturer-specified position.

requirements.text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the rear position lamps and retro-reflectors shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use".
requirements.test_case: With the movable component in each fixed open position, measure the hidden share of the apparent surface and confirm it does not exceed 50 per cent.

requirements.text: With the exception of retro-reflectors, the rear position, stop and reversing lamps, even bearing an approval mark, are deemed not to be present when they cannot be made to operate by the sole installation of a light source and/or a fuse.
requirements.test_case: Verify on the installed vehicle that each lamp function operates without anything other than fitting a light source and/or fuse.

requirements.text: Lamps approved with light source(s) according to UN Regulation No. 37, except when such light sources are used as non-replaceable light sources, shall be fitted in a vehicle in such a way that the light source can be correctly replaced without the need for expert assistance and without the need for special tools, other than those provided with the vehicle by the manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Perform a light-source replacement on the installed lamp using only vehicle-supplied tools; pass if correctly replaced without expert help.

requirements.text: Rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control are allowed only provided that the intensity of all such lamps, when combined, grouped or reciprocally incorporated, vary all together in the same manner and in a similar proportion.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensities of the R2/S2 lamps across the variation range and verify they vary together proportionally.

requirements.text: For rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control, in the entire intensity range, the specific prescribed ratio between the luminous intensities of two lamps, if applicable, shall be maintained throughout variation transitions.
requirements.test_case: Measure stop/position intensity ratio during transitions and verify the prescribed ratio is maintained.

requirements.text: There shall be no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of the lamp observed from infinity; no account is taken of obstacles already presented when the lamp was type-approved.
requirements.test_case: Check on the installed vehicle that no vehicle part obstructs the apparent surface within the required angles of geometric visibility.

requirements.text: If, when the lamp is installed, any part of the apparent surface of the lamp is hidden by any further parts of the vehicle, proof shall be furnished that the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.
requirements.test_case: Photometrically measure the lamp with the obscuring parts in place; pass if prescribed values are still met.

requirements.text: In the case of an interdependent lamp system the geometric visibility requirements shall be fulfilled when all its interdependent lamps are operated together.
requirements.test_case: Operate all interdependent lamps together and verify the geometric visibility angles.

requirements.text: A LED module of the lamp need not be replaceable only if so stated in the communication sheet of the component type approval.
requirements.test_case: Check the device approval communication sheet states the LED module is non-replaceable.

requirements.text: The rear position lamps, stop lamps, reversing lamps and rear retro-reflectors shall, where applicable, be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation when installed on a vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Verify each function bears a valid approval mark under the device regulation (R148/R150) specified in paragraph 6.

requirements.text: In case of light-signalling lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo, the lamp shall be type approved according to the requirements of the UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Verify R148 approval covering the lamp with logo.

requirements.text: Lamps installed on the vehicle and approved for one or more replaceable light source categories according to Regulations Nos. 37, 99 or 128 shall be fitted with light sources approved according to these light source categories only; this does not concern light source modules, LED modules and non-replaceable light sources, except when they are required to be approved by the applicable Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Inspect fitted light sources and confirm they carry approval for the categories stated in the lamp approval.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be present on motor vehicles (mandatory).
requirements.test_case: Inspect the M1 vehicle installation and confirm at least one reversing lamp is fitted.

requirements.text: On motor vehicles of category M1, one reversing lamp device is mandatory and a second device is optional.
requirements.test_case: Count reversing lamps on the M1 vehicle; pass if one or two devices are fitted.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 23, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Check the approval mark on the lamp for a valid R23 or R148 reversing lamp approval.

requirements.text: In height, the reversing lamp shall be positioned not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground.
requirements.test_case: Measure the apparent surface height of the reversing lamp on the unladen vehicle; pass if between 250 mm and 1,200 mm.

requirements.text: In length, the reversing lamp shall be positioned at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installation and confirm the reversing lamp is located at the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: For a reversing lamp installed at the rear of the vehicle, the geometric visibility defined by angles α and β as specified in paragraph 2.10.7. shall be α = 15° upwards and 5° downwards, and β = 45° to right and to left if there is only one device.
requirements.test_case: Verify the apparent surface is visible over 15° up, 5° down and 45° left and right.

requirements.text: For reversing lamps installed at the rear of the vehicle, the geometric visibility defined by angles α and β as specified in paragraph 2.10.7. shall be α = 15° upwards and 5° downwards, and β = 45° outwards and 30° inwards if there are two devices.
requirements.test_case: Verify each lamp's apparent surface is visible over 15° up, 5° down, 45° outwards and 30° inwards.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installed lamp and confirm its reference axis points rearwards.

requirements.text: The electrical connections of the reversing lamp shall be such that the lamp can be switched ON only if the reverse gear is engaged and if the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is in such a position that operation of the propulsion system is possible.
requirements.test_case: Functional test: lamp lights only with reverse engaged and propulsion system operable.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall not switch ON or remain ON if either the reverse gear is not engaged or the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is not in a position where operation of the propulsion system is possible.
requirements.test_case: Disengage reverse or switch off the propulsion system and confirm the lamp switches OFF and cannot be switched ON.

requirements.text: A tell-tale indicating failure of the reversing lamp is mandatory if required by the component regulation.
requirements.test_case: Check component approval; if failure indication is required, simulate failure and confirm the tell-tale activates.

requirements.text: Stop lamp devices of S1 or S2 categories shall be mandatory on all categories of vehicles, including M1 vehicles.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the M1 vehicle installation and confirm that S1 or S2 category stop lamps are fitted.

requirements.text: The stop lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Check the approval mark on the lamp and its approval certificate, and confirm an S1/S2 approval under R7 02+ or R148 00+.

requirements.text: Two S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices shall be installed on all categories of vehicles.
requirements.test_case: Count the S1/S2 stop lamps fitted to the vehicle and check that there are exactly two, one in each rear lamp.

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, for S1 or S2 categories devices (stop lamps), that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure on the vehicle the lateral distance from the outermost point of the stop lamp apparent surface to the vehicle outer edge; pass if ≤ 400 mm.

requirements.text: For S1 or S2 categories devices (stop lamps), the mounting height above the ground shall be not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).
requirements.test_case: Measure the height of the stop lamp apparent surface above ground per paragraph 5.8.1; pass if between 350 mm and 1,500 mm (or 2,100 mm where justified).

requirements.text: For S1 or S2 categories devices (stop lamps), the position in length shall be at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installed stop lamp; pass if it is located at the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: For S1 or S2 categories devices (stop lamps), the horizontal angle of geometric visibility shall be 45° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Verify on the vehicle that the stop lamp apparent surface is visible over 45° left and right of the longitudinal axis; pass if unobstructed over the full range.

requirements.text: For S1 or S2 categories devices (stop lamps), the vertical angle of geometric visibility shall be 15° above and below the horizontal.
requirements.test_case: Verify on the vehicle that the stop lamp apparent surface is visible over 15° above and below the horizontal.

requirements.text: For stop lamps of categories S1 and S2 mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward horizontal angle of 45° may be reduced to no less than 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: Measure mounting height; if below 750 mm, verify inward visibility of at least 20° under the H plane.

requirements.text: For S1 or S2 categories stop lamps mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward vertical angle of 15° may be reduced to no less than 5°.
requirements.test_case: Measure mounting height; if below 750 mm, verify downward visibility of at least 5°.

requirements.text: The stop lamps shall be oriented towards the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect installation; pass if stop lamp reference axis points rearwards.

requirements.text: All stop lamps shall be switched ON simultaneously when the braking system provides the relevant signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.
requirements.test_case: Apply the braking signal on the vehicle; pass if all stop lamps switch ON simultaneously.

requirements.text: For the stop lamps, a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component regulation.
requirements.test_case: Simulate stop lamp failure; if required by the component regulation, verify the failure tell-tale activates.

requirements.text: The presence of rear position lamps of R or R1 or R2 categories is mandatory.
requirements.test_case: Inspect vehicle; pass if rear position lamps of category R, R1 or R2 are fitted.

requirements.text: For the rear position lamps, that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure lateral distance from outermost point of rear position lamp apparent surface to vehicle outer edge; pass if ≤ 400 mm.

requirements.text: The rear position lamps shall be mounted above the ground not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).
requirements.test_case: Measure height of rear position lamp apparent surface per paragraph 5.8.1; pass if within 350–1,500 mm (or 2,100 mm where justified).

requirements.text: The rear position lamps shall be positioned in length at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect installation; pass if rear position lamps are at the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The rear position lamps shall have a horizontal angle of geometric visibility of 45° inwards and 80° outwards.
requirements.test_case: Verify on vehicle that the rear position lamp apparent surface is visible from 45° inwards to 80° outwards.

requirements.text: The rear position lamps shall have a vertical angle of geometric visibility of 15° above and below the horizontal.
requirements.test_case: Verify visibility of the rear position lamp apparent surface over 15° above and below horizontal.

requirements.text: Where a rear position lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward horizontal angle of 45° may be reduced to no less than 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: If mounting height below 750 mm, verify inward visibility of at least 20° under the H plane.

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, as an alternative to paragraph 6.10.5.1., at the discretion of the manufacturer and only if a rear side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, the rear position lamps shall have a horizontal angle of 45° outwards to 45° inwards (inward angle reducible to 20° under the H plane where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm).
requirements.test_case: Confirm rear side-marker lamp fitted; verify visibility from 45° outwards to 45° inwards.

requirements.text: Under the alternative of paragraph 6.10.5.2., to be considered visible, the rear position lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 square centimetres, excluding the illuminating surface area of any retro-reflector that does not transmit light.
requirements.test_case: Measure unobstructed apparent surface at the boundary angles excluding non-transmitting retro-reflector area; pass if ≥ 12.5 cm².

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, under the alternative of paragraph 6.10.5.2., the rear position lamps shall have a vertical angle of 15° above and below the horizontal (downward angle reducible to 5° where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm).
requirements.test_case: Verify visibility over 15° above and below horizontal (5° downward if below 750 mm).

requirements.text: The rear position lamps shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.test_case: Inspect installation; pass if reference axis points rearwards.

requirements.text: The electrical connections of the rear position lamps shall be in accordance with paragraph 5.11.
requirements.test_case: Check wiring/switching of rear position lamps against paragraph 5.11 on the vehicle.

requirements.text: For the rear position lamps, a closed-circuit tell-tale is mandatory; this requirement does not apply when daytime running lamps are switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle with rear position lamps ON (DRL OFF) and verify a closed-circuit tell-tale is lit.

requirements.text: The closed-circuit tell-tale of the rear position lamps shall be combined with that of the front position lamps; this requirement does not apply when daytime running lamps are switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Switch on position lamps and verify a single shared tell-tale indicates both front and rear position lamps.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, is mandatory on motor vehicles.
requirements.test_case: Verify the M1 vehicle is fitted with non-triangular rear retro-reflectors.

requirements.text: The number of rear retro-reflectors, non-triangular, shall be two, type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3, or in the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 150.
requirements.test_case: Check that two rear retro-reflectors are fitted and carry Class IA or IB approval marks under R3 (02+) or R150 (00+).

requirements.text: In width, that point on the illuminating surface of the rear retro-reflector which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lateral distance from the outermost point of the illuminating surface to the vehicle's extreme outer edge; pass if ≤ 400 mm.

requirements.text: In height, the rear retro-reflector shall be above the ground not less than 250 mm nor more than 900 mm (not more than 1,200 mm if grouped with any rear lamp(s), 1,500 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 900 mm or 1,200 mm respectively).
requirements.test_case: Measure the mounting height of the retro-reflector above ground; pass if 250-900 mm (or ≤1,200 mm if grouped with rear lamps, ≤1,500 mm if bodywork prevents).

requirements.text: In length, the rear retro-reflector shall be at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle and verify the retro-reflector is located at the rear.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of the rear retro-reflector shall be defined by a horizontal angle of 30° inwards and outwards.
requirements.test_case: Verify the illuminating surface is unobstructed over 30° inwards and outwards horizontally.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of the rear retro-reflector shall be defined by a vertical angle of 10° above and below horizontal; where the retro-reflector is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 10° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Verify visibility over 10° up and 10° down (5° down if mounted below 750 mm).

requirements.text: The orientation of the rear retro-reflector shall be rearwards.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installed retro-reflector and verify its reference axis faces rearwards.

requirements.text: When daytime running lamps are switched ON, the rear position lamps shall be switched ON.
requirements.test_case: On the vehicle, activate the daytime running lamps and verify that the rear position lamps are switched ON simultaneously.

requirements.text: The rear position lamps may be switched OFF when the daytime running lamps are switched ON only as long as the ambient light conditions outside the vehicle are above 7,000 lux (measured according to the requirements of Annex 13).
requirements.test_case: With DRL ON, vary the ambient light per Annex 13 and verify that the rear position lamps are OFF only above 7,000 lux and switch ON at or below it.

requirements.text: On motor vehicles (M1), the emergency stop signal is mandatory and, where given by the stop lamps, shall be given by the simultaneous operation of all the stop lamps fitted as described in paragraph 6.23.7.
requirements.test_case: Trigger the emergency braking logic signal on the vehicle and verify that all fitted stop lamps operate simultaneously.

requirements.text: All the lamps of the emergency stop signal shall flash in phase at a frequency of 4.0 ± 1.0 Hz.
requirements.test_case: Activate the emergency stop signal and measure the flashing frequency and phase of all lamps; pass if in phase and within 3.0 to 5.0 Hz.

requirements.text: The emergency stop signal shall operate independently of other lamps.
requirements.test_case: Activate the emergency stop signal with other lamps in various states and verify its operation is unaffected.

requirements.text: The emergency stop signal shall be switched ON and OFF automatically.
requirements.test_case: Verify by vehicle test that the emergency stop signal activates and deactivates without manual control.

requirements.text: The emergency stop signal shall be switched ON only when the vehicle speed is above 50 km/h and the braking system is providing the emergency braking logic signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.
requirements.test_case: Test emergency braking below and above 50 km/h; pass if the signal activates only above 50 km/h with the emergency braking logic signal present.

requirements.text: The emergency stop signal shall be automatically switched OFF if the emergency braking logic signal as defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H is no longer provided or if the hazard warning signal is activated.
requirements.test_case: Remove the emergency braking logic signal and separately activate the hazard warning signal; pass if the emergency stop signal switches OFF in both cases.

requirements.text: A separate approval is required for each lamp (rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp) listed in paragraph 1.
requirements.test_case: Check the approval documentation covers each function (R1/R2, S1/S2, AR) with its own approval.

requirements.text: When two or more lamps are part of the same unit of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, approval may be granted only if each of these lamps satisfy the provisions set out in this Regulation or in another Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Verify test reports show each function of the combination lamp (position, stop, reversing, retro-reflector) complies with its applicable Regulation.

requirements.text: Lamps not satisfying the provisions of any of those Regulations shall not be part of the unit of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps.
requirements.test_case: Review the lamp content list; confirm no function in the housing lacks compliance with an applicable Regulation.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall be identified by the symbol R1 (steady) or R2 (variable), the stop lamp by the symbol S1 (steady) or S2 (variable), and the reversing lamp by the symbol AR, as listed in Table 1.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking for the correct function symbols R1/R2, S1/S2 and AR matching the approved intensity variant.

requirements.text: Every device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraphs 3.3.3.2. to 3.3.3.6.
requirements.test_case: Inspect drawing and sample for a marking area large enough for all required markings.

requirements.text: All markings shall be clearly legible and indelible.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect markings and perform rub/durability check; markings remain legible.

requirements.text: With regard to the size of the approval marking, the value for "a" shall be at least 5 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure the approval mark dimension a; pass if ≥ 5 mm.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking for circle with E and country number.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the four to six-digit sequential number, being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2., and this sequential number shall be placed close to the approval mark.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking for a 4-6 digit sequential number adjacent to the E-mark.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the symbols identifying the light signalling lamps prescribed in paragraph 3.2.4.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking for the function symbols of all approved functions.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the number of this Regulation followed by the letter 'R' and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking for '148R' followed by the series digits (e.g. 01).

requirements.text: On lamps which cannot be mounted on either side of the vehicle indiscriminately, the approval marking shall include a horizontal arrow showing in which position the lamp is to be mounted.
requirements.test_case: Inspect handed lamp samples for a horizontal arrow in the marking.

requirements.text: For rear position lamps which cannot be mounted on either side of the vehicle indiscriminately, the horizontal arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Verify arrow points outboard when lamp is in its mounting position.

requirements.text: If applicable, the additional letter "D" shall be placed to the right side of the symbol mentioned in paragraph 3.2.4. on lamps which may be used as part of an assembly of two independent lamps.
requirements.test_case: Inspect marking for 'D' to the right of the function symbol.

requirements.text: Lamps shall bear the approval marking.
requirements.test_case: Inspect sample for presence of the complete approval marking.

requirements.text: Lamps shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Inspect sample for applicant trade name or mark.

requirements.text: Lamps, with the exception of lamps with non-replaceable light sources, shall bear a marking indicating the category or categories of light source(s) prescribed.
requirements.test_case: If replaceable light sources are used, inspect for light source category marking.

requirements.text: Lamps with an electronic light source control gear, and/or a variable luminous intensity control, and/or a secondary operating mode, and/or non-replaceable light sources shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage.
requirements.test_case: Inspect sample for rated voltage or voltage range marking.

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the light source module(s) shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Inspect module for applicant trade name or mark.

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the light source module(s) shall bear the specific identification code of the module, comprising the starting letters "MD" followed by the approval mark without the circle as prescribed in paragraph 3.3.2.1.1., followed by additional symbols or characters in case several non-identical light source modules are used.
requirements.test_case: Inspect module for 'MD' code with approval mark without circle.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall be placed on an inner or outer part (transparent or not) of the lamp which is not designed to be separated from the transparent part of the lamp emitting the light.
requirements.test_case: Verify marking location is on a part not separable from the light-emitting outer lens.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall be visible when the lamp is fitted on the vehicle or when a movable part such as the hood or boot lid or a door is opened.
requirements.test_case: Check on vehicle (or mock-up) that the marking is visible fitted or with boot lid/door open.

requirements.text: If the outer lens of the device is designed to be separated from the main body, the approval marking shall be placed on both the detachable lens and the main body.
requirements.test_case: If lens is detachable, inspect both lens and housing for approval marking.

requirements.text: The approval marking and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.3.2., 3.3.3.3., 3.3.3.4., 3.3.3.5. (b) and 3.3.3.6. shall be affixed on the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Inspect lamp sample for all required markings affixed on the lamp.

requirements.text: Where a single approval mark is affixed to grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps that comply with several UN Regulations, the marking shall be visible after installation of the lamps.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp installed or in its installation position and confirm the single approval mark is visible.

requirements.text: Where a single approval mark is affixed to grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, no part of the lamps that transmits light can be removed without at the same time removing the approval mark.
requirements.test_case: Check the mark location (e.g. on the outer lens or housing part carrying the lens) so that removing any light-transmitting part also removes the mark.

requirements.text: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.
requirements.test_case: Measure the mark component dimensions and compare with the minimum sizes required by each applicable Regulation.

requirements.text: Each lamp submitted for approval shall conform to the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4. and 5.
requirements.test_case: Verify by test report that the rear position, stop and reversing lamps meet all requirements of paragraphs 4 and 5.

requirements.text: The requirements contained in sections 5 "General specifications" and 6 "Individual specifications" (and in the Annexes referenced) of UN Regulation No. 48 and its series of amendments in force at the time of application for the lamp type approval, pertinent to each lamp and to the category of vehicle on which the lamp is intended to be installed (M1), shall be applied where its verification at the moment of lamp type approval is feasible.
requirements.test_case: Check the R48 sections 5 and 6 requirements verifiable on the device (e.g. geometric visibility, colour) for each function during type approval testing.

requirements.text: The lamps must be so designed and constructed that in normal conditions of use, and notwithstanding the vibrations to which they may be subjected in such use, their satisfactory operation remains assured and they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Perform vibration/durability evaluation and confirm photometric and colorimetric characteristics are retained afterwards.

requirements.text: In the case of a rear position lamp reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp, these functions shall either be provided by multiple light sources (for instance, a double filament light source) or be intended for use in a vehicle equipped with a tell-tale indicating failure for the lamps.
requirements.test_case: Review the circuit design to confirm multiple light sources provide the functions, or that the lamp is restricted to vehicles with a failure tell-tale.

requirements.text: The stop lamps and reversing lamps shall not incorporate a logo.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the stop and reversing lamp optics and lens areas and confirm no logo is present.

requirements.text: If a manufacturer logo is incorporated in the internal structure of the optical components and/or the texture of the outer lens inside the apparent surface of a lamp (function), only one logo shall be incorporated and all requirements for the specific function of this Regulation shall be fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp for a single logo and verify the function still meets all photometric and colorimetric requirements.

requirements.text: If a logo is incorporated in a lamp, irrespective of the marking requirements in paragraph 3.3., only the logo of the brand name of the vehicle manufacturer or the body manufacturer is allowed.
requirements.test_case: Check the logo is the vehicle or body manufacturer brand logo, as confirmed by the applicant statement.

requirements.text: If a logo is incorporated in a lamp, the enclosed light emitting surface of the logo (incorporating transparent and non-transparent components of the logo) in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 100 cm2.
requirements.test_case: Measure the logo enclosed light emitting surface projected along the reference axis; pass if ≤ 100 cm2.

requirements.text: In a single lamp containing more than one light source, a group of light sources, wired so that the failure of any one of them causes all of them to stop emitting light, shall be considered to be one light source.
requirements.test_case: Review the LED wiring to identify groups that fail together and treat each as one light source in the failure assessment.

requirements.text: In case of failure of any one light source in a single lamp containing more than one light source, either the light intensity shall comply with the minimum intensity required in the pertinent table of standard light distribution as shown in Annex 3 (with the maximum intensities not exceeded when all light sources are illuminated), or a signal for activation of a tell-tale indicating failure, as indicated in paragraphs 6.4.8., 6.7.8., 6.9.8, 6.10.8., 6.11.8., 6.12.8., 6.13.8. and 6.18.8. of UN Regulation No. 48, shall be produced.
requirements.test_case: Simulate failure of each light source and measure intensities against Annex 3 minimum values, or verify the failure tell-tale signal is generated.

requirements.text: In case of failure of the variable intensity control of a rear position lamp category R2 emitting more than the maximum value of category R1, requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category shall be fulfilled automatically.
requirements.test_case: Simulate failure of the variable intensity control and verify the lamp automatically reverts to steady intensity within the category limits.

requirements.text: The lamp shall only be equipped with replaceable light source(s) approved according to UN Regulations Nos. 37, 99 and/or 128 (provided that no restriction on the use is made at the time of application for type approval), and/or light source module(s) and/or non-replaceable light source(s).
requirements.test_case: Review the bill of materials and confirm the LED light sources are non-replaceable, light source modules or UN-approved replaceable light sources.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), the design of the lamp shall be such that the light source(s) can be fixed in no other position but the correct one.
requirements.test_case: Attempt to fit the light source in alternative positions; pass if only the correct position is possible.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), the light source(s) holder shall conform to the characteristics given in IEC Publication 60061, the holder data sheet relevant to the category of light source(s) prescribed applying, and where a category of LED substitute light source(s) is also prescribed, the holder data sheet relevant to that category also applying.
requirements.test_case: Gauge the holder against the relevant IEC 60061 data sheet dimensions.

requirements.text: Light Signalling Devices shall not generate radiated or power line disturbances, which cause a malfunction of other electric/electronic systems of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Verify by EMC emission testing (e.g. UN R10) that no disturbances causing malfunction of vehicle systems are generated.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that it can only be fitted in the designated and correct position and can only be removed with the use of tool(s).
requirements.test_case: Attempt fitting in incorrect positions and removal without tools; pass if neither is possible.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that it is tamperproof.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the module design for tamperproof construction.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), regardless of the use of tool(s), the light source module shall not be interchangeable with any replaceable UN approved light source and/or any other replaceable light source module having different characteristics that is located in the same lamp housing.
requirements.test_case: Attempt to interchange the module with approved light sources and other modules in the housing; pass if not possible.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), when the light source module is removed and replaced by another module provided by the applicant and bearing the same light source module identification code, the photometric requirements of the device shall be met.
requirements.test_case: Replace the module with another of the same identification code and re-measure photometry against the requirements.

requirements.text: All measurements, photometric and colorimetric, shall be made with respect to the conditions of paragraph 4.8., with the methods of measurement given in Annex 3.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the test report states measurements were performed per paragraph 4.8 conditions and Annex 3 methods.

requirements.text: In the case of replaceable UN approved light sources, all measurements shall be made using standard light sources as specified in R.E.5.
requirements.test_case: Verify the test report records use of R.E.5 standard light sources.

requirements.text: In the case of a lamp equipped with light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s), all measurements shall be made with the light source(s) present in the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report confirms photometric and colorimetric measurements were taken with the lamp's own LED sources fitted.

requirements.text: During photometric measurements, stray reflections shall be avoided by appropriate masking.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the photometric set-up for masking preventing stray reflections.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensities shall be measured with the light source continuously lit.
requirements.test_case: Confirm intensity measurements of each function were made with the light sources continuously lit.

requirements.text: The limits of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the light-signalling lamp shall be determined.
requirements.test_case: Check that the apparent surface limits for each function in the direction of the reference axis are determined and documented.

requirements.text: Unless otherwise specified, the voltage supplied at the lamp for testing shall be either 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems).
requirements.test_case: Verify the test supply voltage at the lamp is 13.5 V for a 12 V system (or 6.75 V / 28 V as applicable).

requirements.text: In case of a lamp controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the lamp was operated during testing per the applicant's specified operating conditions.

requirements.text: In case of a lamp not controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, in the case of light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s), the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Confirm operating conditions during testing match the applicant's specification.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, on the reference axis (HV), be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
requirements.test_case: Measure the intensity at HV on both samples for each function and verify it is not below the paragraph 5 minimum.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, in no direction where the lamp is visible, exceed the maximum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
requirements.test_case: Scan all visible directions on both samples and verify no value exceeds the paragraph 5 maximum.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, outside the reference axis, be not less than the product of the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5. by the percentage specified in the pertinent light distribution figure in Annex 3, or not less than the intensity value specified in the pertinent light distribution figure in Annex 3, for each direction in question.
requirements.test_case: Measure at each grid point of the Annex 3 figure and verify intensity ≥ minimum × percentage (or the stated value).

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, within the angles of geometric visibility defined in the tables in Annex 2, be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
requirements.test_case: Measure across the Annex 2 geometric visibility angles and verify intensity is not below the specified minimum.

requirements.text: The provisions of the relevant paragraphs of Annex 3 on local variations of intensity shall be observed.
requirements.test_case: Evaluate the light distribution against the Annex 3 local variation provisions.

requirements.text: An interdependent lamp system shall meet the requirements when all its interdependent lamps are operated together.
requirements.test_case: Operate all interdependent lamps together and verify photometric compliance.

requirements.text: If the interdependent lamp system providing the rear position lamp is partly mounted on the fixed component and partly mounted on a movable component, the interdependent lamp(s) specified by the applicant shall meet the outboard geometric visibility colorimetric and photometric requirement, at all fixed positions of the movable component(s).
requirements.test_case: Test the specified interdependent lamps at all fixed positions of the movable component for outboard visibility, colour and photometry.

requirements.text: The variable intensity control shall not generate signals which cause luminous intensities outside the range specified in paragraph 5.
requirements.test_case: Drive the variable intensity control across its signal range and verify intensities stay within the paragraph 5 range.

requirements.text: If a rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp producing either steady or variable luminous intensity, the ratio between the luminous intensities actually measured of the two lamps when turned on simultaneously to the intensity of the rear position lamp when turned on alone should be at least 5:1 in the field delimited by the straight horizontal lines passing through ±5° V and the straight vertical lines passing through ±10° H of the light distribution table.
requirements.test_case: Measure stop+position together and position alone in the ±5° V / ±10° H field and verify ratio ≥5:1.
