requirements.text: If one or both of the reciprocally incorporated rear position and stop lamps contain(s) more than one light source and is (are) considered as a single lamp, the values to be considered for the 5:1 ratio are those obtained with all sources in operation.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the ratio measurement was done with all light sources operating.

requirements.text: Tests for compliance of the luminous intensities shall be carried out according to Annex 8.
requirements.test_case: Verify luminous intensity testing follows the Annex 8 procedure.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted shall be measured inside the field of the light distribution grid defined for the specific function in the relevant paragraph of Annex 3.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity within the Annex 3 grid field for each function.

requirements.text: Outside the field of the light distribution grid no sharp variation of colour shall be observed.
requirements.test_case: Visually/colorimetrically inspect outside the grid for absence of sharp colour variation.

requirements.text: For lamps equipped with non-replaceable light sources, the colorimetric characteristics should be verified with the light sources present in the lamp, in accordance with relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 4.8.
requirements.test_case: Confirm colour measurements were made with the lamp's own non-replaceable LEDs.

requirements.text: To check the colorimetric characteristics, the test procedure described in paragraph 4.8. shall be applied.
requirements.test_case: Confirm colorimetric testing uses the paragraph 4.8 operating and measurement conditions.

requirements.text: For rear position lamps of category R1 (steady), the light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall have a minimum luminous intensity of 4∙10^0 cd on the reference axis (Par. 4.8.3.1. (a)), as specified in Table 4.
requirements.test_case: Measure HV intensity on both samples and verify ≥4 cd.

requirements.text: For rear position lamps of category R1 (steady), the maximum luminous intensity (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)) shall be 1.7∙10^1 cd when used as a single lamp and 8.5∙10^0 cd when used as a lamp marked "D", as specified in Table 4.
requirements.test_case: Scan all visible directions and verify ≤17 cd (≤8.5 cd if marked D).

requirements.text: For rear position lamps of category R1 (steady), the standard light distribution (Par. 4.8.3.1. (c)) shall meet Figure A3-I, as specified in Table 4.
requirements.test_case: Measure at Figure A3-I grid points and verify the percentage minima are met.

requirements.text: For rear position lamps of category R1 (steady), within the angles of geometric visibility defined in Table A2-1 (Par. 4.8.3.1. (d)), the luminous intensity shall be not less than 5∙10^-2 cd, as specified in Table 4.
requirements.test_case: Measure across Table A2-1 visibility angles and verify ≥0.05 cd.

requirements.text: For rear position lamps of category R2 (variable), the maximum luminous intensity (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)) shall be 4.2∙10^1 cd when used as a single lamp and 2.1∙10^1 cd when used as a lamp marked "D", as specified in Table 4.
requirements.test_case: Verify maximum intensity ≤42 cd (≤21 cd if marked D) in all visible directions.

requirements.text: For rear position lamps reciprocally incorporated with stop lamps, a luminous intensity of up to 6.0∙10^1 cd shall be permitted only below a plane forming an angle of 5° with and downward from the horizontal plane.
requirements.test_case: Verify intensities above the table maximum occur only below 5° down and do not exceed 60 cd.

requirements.text: For rear position lamps of category R2 (variable), the standard light distribution (Par. 4.8.3.1. (c)) shall meet Figure A3-I, and within the angles of geometric visibility of Table A2-1 (Par. 4.8.3.1. (d)) the luminous intensity shall be not less than 5∙10^-2 cd, as specified in Table 4.
requirements.test_case: Verify Figure A3-I distribution and ≥0.05 cd across Table A2-1 angles.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall meet the failure provisions of paragraph 4.6.
requirements.test_case: Assess rear position lamp failure behaviour against paragraph 4.6.

requirements.text: The colour of light emitted by the rear position lamp shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity coordinates of the rear position lamp and verify they fall in the red colour boundaries.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied of the stop lamp shall meet the requirements in Table 7.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric measurement of both samples; all Table 7 values for the declared category met.

requirements.text: For a stop lamp of category S1 (steady), the minimum luminous intensity shall be 6.0∙10^1 cd and the maximum luminous intensity shall be 2.60∙10^2 cd when used as a single lamp or 1.30∙10^2 cd when used as a lamp marked "D", with the standard light distribution of Figure A3-I and the angles of geometric visibility of Table A2-1, as given in Table 7.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensity on the reference axis and across Figure A3-I grid; min ≥ 60 cd, max ≤ 260 cd (≤ 130 cd if marked D).

requirements.text: For a stop lamp of category S2 (variable), the minimum luminous intensity shall be 6.0∙10^1 cd and the maximum luminous intensity shall be 7.30∙10^2 cd when used as a single lamp or 3.65∙10^2 cd when used as a lamp marked "D", with the standard light distribution of Figure A3-I and the angles of geometric visibility of Table A2-1, as given in Table 7.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensity under variable-intensity conditions; min ≥ 60 cd, max ≤ 730 cd (≤ 365 cd if marked D).

requirements.text: For a stop lamp of category S1, the minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility of Table A2-1 shall be 3∙10^-1 cd, as given in Table 7.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensity at the boundary of the Table A2-1 geometric visibility angles; each value ≥ 0.3 cd.

requirements.text: The stop lamp shall comply with the failure provisions of paragraph 4.6.
requirements.test_case: Simulate light source failure per paragraph 4.6 and verify the specified behaviour.

requirements.text: For a reversing lamp of category AR, the minimum luminous intensity shall be 8.0∙10^1 cd, with the standard light distribution of Figure A3-V, as given in Table 10.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensity on the reference axis and over Figure A3-V grid; minimum ≥ 80 cd.

requirements.text: For a reversing lamp of category AR, the maximum luminous intensity shall not exceed 3.00∙10^2 cd in or above the H-plane, 6.00∙10^2 cd below the H-plane down to 5°D, and 8.00∙10^3 cd below 5°D, as given in Table 10.
requirements.test_case: Scan intensity in the three vertical zones; ≤ 300 cd at/above H, ≤ 600 cd down to 5°D, ≤ 8000 cd below 5°D.

requirements.text: Where the reversing lamp is intended to be installed on a vehicle exclusively in a pair of devices and the photometric intensity is verified only up to an angle of 30° inwards, a photometric value of at least 2.5∙10^1 cd shall be satisfied, and this condition shall be clearly explained in the application for approval and relating documents.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensity up to 30° inwards; ≥ 25 cd; check the pair condition is declared in the application.

requirements.text: The colour of light emitted by the reversing lamp shall be white.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity of the reversing lamp light through its lens zone; within the white colour boundaries.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp (R1, R2) shall have minimum horizontal angles of geometric visibility of 45° inboard / 80° outboard and minimum vertical angles of 15° above / 15° below, as given in Table A2-1 (angles shown for lamps mounted on the right side of the vehicle).
requirements.test_case: Check the lamp in its mounting position: the light-emitting surface is visible throughout 45° inboard / 80° outboard horizontally and 15° above / 15° below vertically.

requirements.text: For a rear position lamp (R1, R2) mounted with the H-plane below 750 mm, the minimum horizontal angles of geometric visibility below the H-plane may be reduced to 20° inboard / 80° outboard.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the H-plane height is below 750 mm and verify visibility of at least 20° inboard / 80° outboard below the H-plane.

requirements.text: For a rear position lamp (R1, R2) to be installed with the H-plane of the lamp at a mounting height of less than 750 mm, the minimum vertical angles of geometric visibility may be reduced to 15° above / 5° below.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the H-plane height is below 750 mm and verify vertical visibility of at least 15° above / 5° below.

requirements.text: Unless specified otherwise, the values shown in Figures A3-I to A3-XV give, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities as a percentage of the minimum intensities required, which shall be mathematically rounded down to three significant digits.
requirements.test_case: Compute the required minimum at each grid point as the percentage of the minimum, rounded down to three significant digits, and compare with the measured intensities.

requirements.text: Where the rear position lamp is intended to be installed at a mounting height (using the H plane specified by the manufacturer) equal to or less than 750 mm above the ground, the photometric intensity is verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
requirements.test_case: For a declared mounting height ≤ 750 mm, verify the photometric grid of the rear position lamp down to 5° below H only.

requirements.text: Where the stop lamp of category S1, S2 or MS is intended to be installed at a mounting height (using the H plane specified by the manufacturer) equal to or less than 750 mm above the ground, the photometric intensity is verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
requirements.test_case: For a declared mounting height ≤ 750 mm, verify the photometric grid of the stop lamp down to 5° below H only.

requirements.text: The direction H = 0° and V = 0° shall correspond to the reference axis, which passes through the centre of reference and, on the vehicle, is horizontal, parallel to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle and oriented in the required direction of visibility.
requirements.test_case: Check that the goniometric measurements of each function are referenced to the manufacturer-declared reference axis and centre of reference.

requirements.text: Within the field of light distribution schematically shown as a grid, the light intensity in each direction of a part of the field formed by the grid lines shall meet at least the lowest minimum value being shown on the grid lines surrounding the questioned direction as a percentage.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensities between grid points of each function and verify each is at least the lowest surrounding grid-line minimum.

requirements.text: In the case of reversing lamps, if visual examination of a lamp appears to reveal substantial local variations of intensity, a check shall be made to ensure that no intensity measured between two of the directions of measurement is below 50 per cent of the lower minimum intensity of the two prescribed for these directions of measurement.
requirements.test_case: If local variations are seen on the reversing lamp, measure between measurement directions and verify no value is below 50% of the lower of the two prescribed minima.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall meet, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities given as a percentage of the minimum intensities required (see Table 4) in the standard light distribution of Figure A3-I.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric measurement of the rear position lamp at the Figure A3-I grid points; each value ≥ the stated percentage of the required minimum.

requirements.text: The stop lamp of category S1 or S2 shall meet, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities given as a percentage of the minimum intensities required (see Table 7) in the standard light distribution of Figure A3-I.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric measurement of the stop lamp at the Figure A3-I grid points; each value ≥ the stated percentage of the required minimum.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall meet, at the measuring points expressed in degrees of angle with the axis of reference, the minimum intensities in cd given in Figure A3-V.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric measurement of the reversing lamp at the Figure A3-V points; each value ≥ the minimum in cd shown.

requirements.text: For the reversing lamp using light source technologies other than incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured after 1 minute and after 10 minutes of operation shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
requirements.test_case: Operate the LED reversing lamp and measure (or calculate via HV ratio) intensities at 1 min and 10 min; verify all test points within minimum and maximum limits.

requirements.text: For the rear position lamp and the stop lamp using light source technologies other than incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured after 1 min and either after 30 minutes of operation or after photometric stability has occurred shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
requirements.test_case: Operate the LED rear position and stop lamps and measure intensities at 1 min and at 30 min (or photometric stability); verify all test points within minimum and maximum limits.

requirements.text: Depending on the light source technology, the luminous intensity distribution of the rear position lamp shall, in addition to paragraph 1, be checked for compliance at 4 seconds after switch ON, using HV as reference coordinate, as listed in Table A8-1.
requirements.test_case: Measure rear position lamp intensity at HV 4 s after switch ON and scale the distribution; verify compliance with limits (or deemed compliant per 2.1.2 for LED only).

requirements.text: In case a lamp (function) uses LED technology only, the lamp (function) is deemed to comply with the corresponding intensity requirements at all points in time, if the values measured according to paragraph 1.2. are compliant.
requirements.test_case: Confirm each function uses LED only and that values measured per paragraph 1.2 comply; then compliance at all points in time is deemed.

requirements.text: The approval number assigned to the approved retro-reflector type shall be marked on the device following the requirements of paragraph 3.3.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the device and confirm the approval number is marked per paragraph 3.3.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall be identified by the symbol IA if it is an independent retro-reflector for motor vehicles, or IB if it is combined with other signal lamps which are not watertight, as given in Table 1.
requirements.test_case: Verify the class symbol marked and documented matches the construction (IA independent/watertight, IB combined with non-watertight lamps).

requirements.text: The retro-reflector belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the Unique Identifier and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2., or the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the device drawing/sample for a marking space large enough for the UI or approval marking and other markings.

requirements.text: All markings on the retro-reflector shall be clearly legible and indelible.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect markings for legibility and perform a rub/indelibility check; markings must remain legible.

requirements.text: The size of the approval marking shall comply with the value for "a" defined in Table 1 (minimum 5 mm for Class IA and IB retro-reflectors).
requirements.test_case: Measure the approval mark dimension "a"; it must be at least 5 mm.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking for a circle enclosing E and the country number.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the four to six-digit sequential number being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2, placed close to the approval mark.
requirements.test_case: Check the 4-6 digit sequential number is present and adjacent to the approval mark.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the symbols identifying the retro-reflective device prescribed in paragraph 3.2.5. (IA or IB).
requirements.test_case: Check the class symbol IA or IB is part of the marking.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the number of this Regulation followed by the letter "R" and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.
requirements.test_case: Check the marking contains "150R" followed by the series of amendments digits.

requirements.text: Where the approval marking is replaced by the Unique Identifier, the Unique Identifier mark shall follow the format in the example shown in Figure I.
requirements.test_case: Compare the UI marking on the device with the Figure I format.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the device for the applicant's trade name or mark.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector of Class IA or IB shall bear the word "TOP" inscribed horizontally on the highest part of the illuminating surface, if such an indication is necessary to determine without ambiguity the angle or angles of rotation prescribed by the manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Check whether rotation is ambiguous; if so, verify "TOP" is horizontal on the highest part of the illuminating surface.

requirements.text: The approval marking or the Unique Identifier and the markings in paragraph 3.3.4. shall be clearly legible on the retro-reflective device.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the device to confirm approval marking/UI, trade name and TOP marking are clearly legible.

requirements.text: Where a single approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number or Unique Identifier is affixed to the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, it shall be visible after their installation.
requirements.test_case: Check on the installed lamp that the single approval mark is visible.

requirements.text: Where a single approval mark is affixed to the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, no part of these lamps that transmits light can be removed without at the same time removing the approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number or the Unique Identifier.
requirements.test_case: Inspect construction: verify the mark is on a part (e.g. outer lens) such that no light-transmitting part can be removed without removing the mark.

requirements.text: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.
requirements.test_case: Measure the single approval mark components and compare with the smallest minimum size required by R150/R148.

requirements.text: The requirements contained in sections 5. "General specifications" and 6. "Individual specifications" and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections of UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 or 86, and their series of amendments in force at the time of application for the retro-reflecting device type approval, shall apply to the retro-reflector, where their verification at the moment of type approval is feasible.
requirements.test_case: Review the R48 general and individual specifications relevant to rear retro-reflectors on M1 vehicles and confirm the device meets those verifiable at type approval.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall be so constructed that it functions satisfactorily and will continue to do so in normal use.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the design and confirm satisfactory function after the prescribed test sequence.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall not have any defect in design or manufacture that is detrimental to its efficient operation or to its maintenance in good condition.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the samples for design or manufacturing defects; none shall be found.

requirements.text: The components of the retro-reflector or parts thereof shall not be capable of being easily dismantled.
requirements.test_case: Attempt to dismantle the retro-reflector by hand without tools; the components shall not separate easily.

requirements.text: The outer surface of the retro-reflector shall be easy to clean.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the outer lens surface over the retro-reflector and confirm it can be cleaned easily.

requirements.text: The outer surface of the retro-reflector shall not be rough and any protuberances the outer surface may exhibit shall not prevent easy cleaning.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the surface by sight and touch; it shall not be rough and no protuberance shall hinder cleaning.

requirements.text: There shall be no access to the inner surface of the retro-reflector when in normal use.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the assembled lamp and confirm the inner (prism) surface of the retro-reflector is not accessible in normal use.

requirements.text: If the retro-reflector consists of a combined retro-reflecting optical unit and filter, the optical unit and filter shall be so designed that they cannot be separated under normal conditions of use.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the construction; the optical unit and filter shall not be separable under normal conditions of use.

requirements.text: The colouring of the retro-reflecting optical units and filters of the retro-reflector shall not be made by means of paint or varnish.
requirements.test_case: Check material specification and inspect the red retro-reflector; colour shall be in the mass, not painted or varnished.

requirements.text: The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous intensity of the retro-reflector shall be within the limits for the night-time colour of the light retro-reflected from that device, as defined in UN Regulation No. 48.
requirements.test_case: Measure the chromaticity of the reflected light and confirm it lies within the R48 night-time red boundaries.

requirements.text: For testing the colour of the retro-reflector, the device shall be illuminated by CIE Standard Illuminant A, with an angle of divergence of 1/3° and an illumination angle of β1 = β2 = 0° or, if this produces a colourless surface reflection, an angle as specified in Annex 4, Part 1, paragraph 1.1.
requirements.test_case: Set up colorimetric measurement with Illuminant A, 1/3° divergence, β1=β2=0° (or Annex 4 angle) and record trichromatic coordinates.

requirements.text: When tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB shall meet the dimensions and shape requirements set forth in Annex 5.
requirements.test_case: Measure the retro-reflector shape and dimensions against Annex 5 (e.g. non-triangular shape); conform.

requirements.text: When tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB shall meet the photometric and colorimetric requirements as specified in paragraphs 5.1.4. to 5.1.5.
requirements.test_case: Perform photometric and colorimetric tests per 5.1.4 and 5.1.5; all values within limits.

requirements.text: When tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB shall meet the physical and mechanical requirements set forth in paragraph 5.1.7., depending on the nature of the materials and construction of the retro-reflective devices.
requirements.test_case: Perform the physical and mechanical tests per 5.1.7 / Annex 6 and 7; samples pass.

requirements.text: After verification of the general specifications (paragraph 4.) and the specifications of shape and dimensions (Annex 5), the ten samples of the retro-reflector shall be subjected to the heat resistance test described in Part 1 of Annex 6 and at least one hour after this test examined as to their colorimetric characteristics in paragraph 5.1.5. and RI in paragraph 5.1.4., for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle β1 = β2 = 0° or if necessary, in the position defined in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.
requirements.test_case: Perform the Annex 6 Part 1 heat test on ten samples and, after at least one hour, check colour and RI at 20'/0°; values within limits.

requirements.text: The two retro-reflectors giving the minimum and maximum values after the heat resistance test shall then be fully tested as shown in paragraph 5.1.4.
requirements.test_case: Perform full photometric test per 5.1.4 on min and max samples; all points meet Table 3.

requirements.text: The first group of two retro-reflector samples shall be subjected successively to the water penetration test (Part 2 of Annex 6) and then, if this test is satisfactory, to the tests for resistance to fuels and lubricants (Parts 1 and 2 of Annex 7).
requirements.test_case: Perform the water penetration test and then the fuel and lubricant resistance tests on two samples; samples pass.

requirements.text: The second group of two retro-reflector samples shall, if necessary, be subjected to the corrosion test in Part 4 of Annex 6, and then to the abrasive-strength test of the rear face of the retro-reflective device in Part 5 of Annex 6.
requirements.test_case: Perform the corrosion test (if applicable) and the rear-face abrasion test on two samples; samples pass.

requirements.text: The third group of two retro-reflector samples shall be subjected to the test for stability in time of the optical properties of retro-reflective device in Part 3 of Annex 4.
requirements.test_case: Perform the Annex 4 Part 3 stability test on two samples; samples pass.

requirements.text: The fourth group of two retro-reflector samples shall be subjected to the resistance to weathering test (Part 6 of Annex 6).
requirements.test_case: Perform the Annex 6 Part 6 weathering test on two samples; samples pass.

requirements.text: After undergoing the tests referred to in paragraph 5.1.3.1., the retro-reflectors in each group must have a colour which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.5.
requirements.test_case: Measure the colour of each post-test sample; within R48 night-time red limits.

requirements.text: After undergoing the tests referred to in paragraph 5.1.3.1., the retro-reflectors in each group must have a RI which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.4., verified only for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle of β1 = β2 = 0° or, if necessary, in all positions specified in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.
requirements.test_case: Measure RI of each post-test sample at 20', β1=β2=0°; value ≥ 300 mcd/lx for red.

requirements.text: For photometric measurements, only the illuminating surface defined by the planes contiguous to the outermost parts of the optical system of the retro-reflector as indicated by the manufacturer and contained within a circle of 200 mm diameter for Class IA or IB shall be considered, and the illuminating surface itself shall be limited to 100 cm2.
requirements.test_case: Mask the retro-reflector to the declared illuminating surface within a 200 mm circle and ≤ 100 cm2 during photometry.

requirements.text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI values for red retro-reflectors of Class IA or IB at an angle of divergence of 20' shall be equal to or greater than 300 mcd/lx at β1 = 0°, β2 = 0°; 200 mcd/lx at β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°; and 100 mcd/lx at β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°, as given in Table 3.
requirements.test_case: Measure RI at 20' divergence at the Table 3 illumination angles; values ≥ 300/200/100 mcd/lx.

requirements.text: RI values of the retro-reflector lower than those shown in the last two columns of Table 3 are not permissible within the solid angle having the centre of reference as its apex and bounded by the planes intersecting along the lines (β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°) (β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°).
requirements.test_case: Scan RI within the bounded solid angle; no value below the corresponding Table 3 minimum.

requirements.text: Where a retro-reflector of Class IA or Class IB is intended to be installed with its H plane at a mounting height less than 750 mm above the ground, the RI values are verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the declared mounting height; if < 750 mm, verify the downward RI points only to 5° and check that they meet Table 3.

requirements.text: The testing of the colour of the retro-reflector (night-time colour) shall be carried out according to the method described in paragraph 4.2.1.
requirements.test_case: Perform the night-time colour measurement using the 4.2.1 set-up.

requirements.text: The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous flux of the retro-reflector must be within the limits for the night-time colour red as specified in UN Regulation No. 48.
requirements.test_case: Measure the chromaticity of the reflected light; coordinates lie within the R48 night-time red limits.

requirements.text: The retro-reflectors of Classes IA and IB shall be tested in the chronological order of tests given in Table 4.
requirements.test_case: Review the test report and confirm that samples a to j were tested in the sequence of Table 4.

requirements.text: For retro-reflectors of Classes IA and IB, the samples shall be subjected to the heat test of Part 1 of Annex 6 (48 h at 65 °C ± 2 °C), followed by a visual inspection for distortion.
requirements.test_case: Expose the samples for 48 h at 65 ± 2 °C and inspect them; pass if no distortion is visible.

requirements.text: For retro-reflectors of Classes IA and IB, all samples (a to j) shall undergo a visual inspection of the general specifications and a visual inspection of shapes and dimensions according to Annex 5.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect all ten samples against paragraph 4 and Annex 5; pass if no non-conformity is found.

requirements.text: For retro-reflectors of Classes IA and IB, colorimetry shall be checked according to paragraph 4.2. by visual inspection, with trichromatic coordinates measured in case of doubt, after each conditioning stage in Table 4.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the colour visually and measure the trichromatic coordinates if in doubt; pass if they are within the red limits.

requirements.text: For retro-reflectors of Classes IA and IB, photometry according to Part 1 of Annex 4, limited to 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°, shall be performed on the samples after each conditioning stage in Table 4.
requirements.test_case: Measure the CIL at 20' and β1 = β2 = 0° after each stage; pass if the values meet the required minimum.

requirements.text: For retro-reflectors of Classes IA and IB, complete photometry according to Part 1 of Annex 4 shall be performed on two samples.
requirements.test_case: Perform the full photometric measurement on two samples; pass if all values are met.

requirements.text: For retro-reflectors of Classes IA and IB, the samples shall be subjected to the water test of Part 3 of Annex 6 (10 min in normal position and 10 min in inverted position), followed by a visual inspection.
requirements.test_case: Immerse the samples 10 min upright and 10 min inverted, then inspect; pass if no water has penetrated.

requirements.text: For retro-reflectors of Classes IA and IB, the samples shall be subjected to the motor fuels test of Part 1 of Annex 7 (5 min), followed by a visual inspection.
requirements.test_case: Expose the samples to the test fuel for 5 min and inspect them; pass if no visible degradation is found.

requirements.text: For retro-reflectors of Classes IA and IB, the samples shall be subjected to the corrosion test of Part 4 of Annex 6 (24 hours, 2 hours interval, 24 hours), followed by a visual inspection.
requirements.test_case: Run the salt-spray cycle of 24 h, 2 h interval and 24 h, then inspect; pass if no detrimental corrosion is visible.

requirements.text: For retro-reflectors of Classes IA and IB, the samples shall be subjected to the stability in time test of Part 3 of Annex 4, followed by colorimetry (visual inspection or trichromatic coordinates) and photometry limited to 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°.
requirements.test_case: After the stability test, check colour and the CIL at 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°; pass if both are within limits.

requirements.text: For retro-reflectors of Classes IA and IB, the samples shall be subjected to the resistance to weathering test of Part 6 of Annex 6, followed by colorimetry (visual inspection or trichromatic coordinates) and photometry limited to 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°.
requirements.test_case: After weathering, check colour and the CIL at 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°; pass if both are within limits.

requirements.text: When the RI of the retro-reflective device is measured for an angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, it shall be ascertained whether any mirror effect is produced by slightly turning the device.
requirements.test_case: During RI measurement at β1 = β2 = 0°, turn the device slightly and check for any mirror effect.

requirements.text: If any mirror effect is produced when measuring the RI at β1 = β2 = 0°, a reading of the retro-reflective device shall be taken with an angle β of β1 = -5°, β2 = 0°.
requirements.test_case: Where a mirror effect is found, take the RI reading at β1 = -5°, β2 = 0° and verify it meets the specified value.

requirements.text: With an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation, and an angle of divergence of 20', retro-reflective devices which are not marked "TOP" shall be rotated about their axes of reference to the position of minimum RI, which must conform to the value specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Rotate the device at β = 0°, α = 20' to find minimum RI and verify it meets the paragraph 5 value.

requirements.text: When the RI of a retro-reflective device not marked "TOP" is measured for the other angles of illumination and divergence, the retro-reflective device shall be placed in the position corresponding to the value of ε of minimum RI; if the specified values are not attained, the device may be rotated about its axis of reference only ±5° from that position.
requirements.test_case: Measure RI at all other angles with the device at the minimum-RI ε position (±5° allowed) and verify compliance.

requirements.text: With an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 4. of this Regulation, and an angle of divergence of 20', retro-reflective devices marked "TOP" shall be rotated about their axes ±5°, and the RI must not fall below the prescribed value in any position assumed by the device during this rotation.
requirements.test_case: Rotate the TOP-marked device ±5° at β = 0°, α = 20' and verify RI never falls below the prescribed value.

requirements.text: If for the direction β1 = β2 = 0°, and for ε = 0° the RI of the retro-reflective device exceeds the specified value by 50 per cent or more, all measurements for all angles of illumination and divergence shall be made for ε = 0°.
requirements.test_case: Check RI at β = 0°, ε = 0°; if ≥150 % of specified value, perform all measurements at ε = 0°.

requirements.text: For testing the retro-reflection the retro-reflective devices shall be illuminated with a CIE Standard Illuminant A (ISO 11664-2:2007(E)/CIE S 014-2/E:2006) and measured as described in Part 1 of Annex 4.
requirements.test_case: Verify the test lab used CIE Standard Illuminant A for retro-reflection measurement.

requirements.text: The shape of the illuminating surfaces of retro-reflective devices of Class IA or IB shall not be easily confused with the triangular shape, as prescribed for retro-reflectors mentioned in paragraph 2.1., from an observation distance of 10 metres.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the retro-reflector illuminating surface from 10 m; pass if it cannot easily be confused with a triangular shape.

requirements.text: In the case of moulded plastics reflectors of retro-reflecting devices of Classes IA or IB, the retro-reflective device shall be kept for 48 consecutive hours in a dry atmosphere at a temperature of 65 °C ± 2 °C, after which the sample shall be allowed to cool for 1 hour at 23 °C ± 2 °C.
requirements.test_case: Expose the retro-reflector to 65 °C ± 2 °C dry atmosphere for 48 h, then cool 1 h at 23 °C ± 2 °C, and proceed to inspection.

requirements.text: After the resistance to heat test, no cracking or appreciable distortion of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of its optical component must be visible.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the retro-reflector after the heat test; pass if no cracking or appreciable distortion of the optical component is visible.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective device, whether part of a lamp or not, shall be stripped of all removable parts and immersed for 10 minutes in water at a temperature of 50 °C ± 5 °C, the highest point of the upper part of the illuminating surface being 20 mm below the surface of the water.
requirements.test_case: Immerse the stripped retro-reflector (lamp) for 10 min in 50 °C ± 5 °C water with the illuminating surface top 20 mm below the water surface.

requirements.text: The water penetration test shall be repeated after turning the retro-reflective device through 180°, so that the illuminating surface is at the bottom and the rear face is covered by about 20 mm of water.
requirements.test_case: Repeat the 10 min immersion at 50 °C with the device inverted and rear face under about 20 mm of water.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective device sample units shall then be immediately immersed in the same conditions in water at a temperature of 25 °C ± 5 °C.
requirements.test_case: Immediately after the 50 °C immersions, immerse the device under the same conditions in 25 °C ± 5 °C water.

requirements.text: No water shall penetrate to the reflecting surface of the retro-reflecting optical unit; if visual inspection clearly reveals the presence of water, the device shall not be considered to have passed the test.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the reflecting surface after immersion; fail if water is clearly present.

requirements.text: If visual inspection does not reveal the presence of water or in case of doubt, in the case of retro-reflectors, the RI shall be measured by the method described in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation, the retro-reflective device being first lightly shaken to remove excess water from the outside.
requirements.test_case: After shaking off excess water, measure RI per paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. and check it meets the applicable requirements.

requirements.text: For retro-reflective devices of Class IB, at the request of the manufacturer, the moisture and dust tests of Annex 6 Part 3 shall be applied as an alternative test procedure of resistance to water penetration.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report confirms that both the moisture test and the dust test were performed when the alternative procedure was requested.

requirements.text: For the alternative moisture test, a sample device mounted on a test fixture, with initial RI measured and recorded, shall be subjected to a water spray.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report records the initial RI of the fixture-mounted sample before the water spray.

requirements.text: During the water spray test, all drain holes and other openings of the device shall remain open.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the test sample to confirm that no drain hole or opening was sealed during the water spray test.

requirements.text: During the water spray test, the device shall be rotated about its vertical axis at a rate of 4.0 ± 0.5 min-1.
requirements.test_case: Check the test record shows a platform rotation rate within 3.5 to 4.5 min-1.

requirements.text: If the retro-reflector is reciprocally incorporated or grouped with signalling or lighting functions, these functions shall be operated during the water spray test at design voltage according to a cycle of 5 min ON (in flashing mode, where appropriate) and 55 min OFF.
requirements.test_case: Check the test log shows the rear position, stop and reversing lamps operated at design voltage on a 5 min ON / 55 min OFF cycle.

requirements.text: The water spray test shall last 12 hours (12 cycles of 5/55 min).
requirements.test_case: Check the test log shows 12 complete 5/55 min cycles over 12 hours.

requirements.text: After the water spray test, the rotation and the water spray shall be turned OFF and the device allowed to drain for 1 hour with the cabinet door closed.
requirements.test_case: Check the test log records a 1 hour drain period with the cabinet door closed.

requirements.text: Upon completion of the drain period, no standing pool of water shall be formed in the device, or be capable of being formed by tapping or tilting the device.
requirements.test_case: Tap and tilt the device after the drain period; pass if no standing pool of water is present or forms.

requirements.text: After the moisture test, the RI shall be measured according to the method specified in Part 1 of Annex 4 after the exterior of the device has been dried with a dry cotton cloth.
requirements.test_case: Dry the exterior with a cotton cloth, measure the RI per Annex 4 Part 1 and record it against the initial value.

requirements.text: Upon completion of the drain period, the interior of the device shall be observed for moisture accumulation.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the device interior after the drain period and record any moisture accumulation.

requirements.text: For the dust exposure test, a sample device mounted on a test fixture, with the initial RI measured and recorded, shall be exposed to dust.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report records the initial RI of the fixture-mounted sample before dust exposure.

requirements.text: Upon completion of the dust exposure test, the exterior of the device shall be cleaned and dried with a dry cotton cloth and the RI measured according to the method specified in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Clean and dry the exterior, measure the RI per paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. and compare it with the initial value against the applicable criterion.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective devices must be so designed that they retain the prescribed photometric and colorimetric characteristics despite the humidity and corrosive influences to which they are normally exposed.
requirements.test_case: Perform the ISO 9227:2017 saline mist test and verify that the photometric and colorimetric characteristics remain within the prescribed limits.

requirements.text: The resistance of the front surface of the retro-reflective device to tarnishing and of the protection of the rear face to deterioration shall be checked, particularly when an essential metal component seems liable to be attacked.
requirements.test_case: After the corrosion test, inspect the front surface for tarnishing and the rear face protection for deterioration; neither shall be present to a degree impairing function.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective device, or the lamp if the device is combined with a light, shall be stripped of all removable parts and subjected to the action of a saline mist for a period of 50 hours, comprising two periods of exposure of 24 hours each, separated by an interval of two hours during which the sample is allowed to dry.
requirements.test_case: Expose the lamp with integrated retro-reflector, stripped of removable parts, to saline mist for 2 x 24 h with a 2 h drying interval and record the test log.

requirements.text: In the case of retro-reflective devices with essential metal components susceptible to corrosion, the saline mist shall be produced by atomizing, at a temperature of 35 °C ± 2 °C, a saline solution obtained by dissolving 5 parts by weight of sodium chloride in 95 parts of distilled water containing not more than 0.02 per cent of impurities.
requirements.test_case: Verify the test chamber records show 35 °C ± 2 °C and a 5 % NaCl solution in distilled water with not more than 0.02 % impurities.

requirements.text: Immediately after completion of the corrosion test, the sample shall not show signs of excessive corrosion liable to impair the efficiency of the device.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the sample immediately after the saline mist test; pass if there is no excessive corrosion impairing efficiency.

requirements.text: After the corrosion test, the coefficient of retro-reflection RA of the retro-reflective areas, when measured after a recovery period of 48 hours as specified in Part 2 of Annex 6, at an entrance angle of β2 = 5° and an observation angle of α = 20', shall be not less than the value in Table 9 or more than the value in Table 10 respectively.
requirements.test_case: After 48 h recovery measure the retro-reflection value at β2 = 5°, α = 20' and compare with the Table 9 minimum and Table 10 maximum.

requirements.text: Before measuring the coefficient of retro-reflection after the corrosion test, the surface shall be cleaned to remove salt deposits from the saline mist.
requirements.test_case: Confirm that the test record shows the surface was cleaned of salt deposits before the photometric measurement.

requirements.text: For moulded plastics reflectors of Classes IA and IB with an accessible mirror-backed rear face, the reverse side of the retro-reflective device shall be brushed with a hard nylon brush.
requirements.test_case: Verify that the test record shows the rear face was brushed with a hard nylon brush.

requirements.text: After having brushed the rear face of a moulded plastics reflector of Class IA or IB, a cotton cloth soaked in the mixture defined in Part 1 of Annex 7 shall be applied to the said rear face for one minute, then removed and the retro-reflective device left to dry.
requirements.test_case: Apply a cotton cloth soaked in the Annex 7 Part 1 mixture to the rear face for 1 min, then remove it and let the device dry; check the test record.

requirements.text: For mirror-backed retro-reflective devices with an accessible rear face, the RI shall then be measured, according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation, after the whole surface of the mirror-backed rear face has been covered with Indian ink.
requirements.test_case: Cover the whole rear face with Indian ink, measure the RI per paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. and compare it with the required values.

requirements.text: For the resistance to fuels test, a test mixture of 70 vol. per cent of n-heptane and 30 vol. per cent of toluol shall be applied to the retro-reflective device.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report confirms that a 70/30 vol.% n-heptane/toluol mixture was used on the retro-reflector.

requirements.text: After about five minutes following the fuel wipe, the surface of the retro-reflective device shall be inspected visually and must not show any apparent surface changes, except that slight surface cracks will not be objected to.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the surface visually about 5 min after the wipe; pass if there is no apparent surface change other than slight surface cracks.

requirements.text: For the resistance to fuels test of a retro-reflective device, the outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in the test mixture.
requirements.test_case: Lightly wipe the retro-reflector outer and illuminating surface with a cotton cloth soaked in the n-heptane/toluol mixture, as recorded in the test report.

requirements.text: For moulded plastics reflectors of Classes IA and IB, after the lubricating oil resistance test, the RI of the retro-reflective device shall be measured according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Measure the CIL/RI after cleaning per paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. and verify it meets the specified limits of that paragraph.

requirements.text: For moulded plastics reflectors of Classes IA and IB, the outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in a detergent lubricating oil.
requirements.test_case: Wipe the outer and illuminating surface of the retro-reflector lightly with a cotton cloth soaked in detergent lubricating oil and record the procedure.

requirements.text: For moulded plastics reflectors of Classes IA and IB, after about 5 minutes following the application of the detergent lubricating oil, the surface of the retro-reflective device shall be cleaned.
requirements.test_case: After about 5 minutes of oil exposure, clean the surface and confirm by inspection that no oil residue remains before measurement.

requirements.text: The approval number of the retro-reflective device must be placed close to, but in any position in relation to, the circle surrounding the letter "E".
requirements.test_case: Inspect the approval mark on the retro-reflector and confirm the approval number is adjacent to the circle surrounding the letter E.

requirements.text: The digits constituting the approval number of the retro-reflective device must face the same way as the "E".
requirements.test_case: Inspect the approval mark and confirm the approval number digits are oriented the same way as the letter E.

requirements.text: The group of symbols indicating the class of the retro-reflective device must be diametrically opposite the approval number.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the approval mark and confirm the class symbol (e.g. IA or IB) is placed diametrically opposite the approval number relative to the circle.
